title: POST /runner/v1/check-in: the request body
description: PROTOCOL.md §5.9. A body that fails this schema is 422 invalid_check_in. Every field is optional: one that is absent leaves what the platform has recorded for the machine as it is. Other fields are ignored.

os.description: e.g. `linux`. A string of at most 255 characters: any other value, `null` included, is refused.

arch.description: e.g. `amd64`. A string of at most 255 characters: any other value, `null` included, is refused.

facts.description: What the machine reports about itself, e.g. {"docker": "27.1.0"}. It replaces the recorded facts. `null` is refused.
